items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps oily skin feeling clean without stripping it.
A simple hydrating serum adds water-based moisture where your scan shows moderate hydration.
A ceramide moisturizer supports a smoother-looking, comfortable skin surface.
A mineral SPF 50 gives daily sun protection and is a pregnancy-friendly sunscreen choice.

response.routine_note: I left out the 15% lactic acid serum because it is a high-strength leave-on exfoliant, so please check with your prenatal provider before using it during pregnancy. In the meantime, cleanse and moisturize morning and night, and apply the SPF every morning.
